concepts.statement_en: Apply efficient, effective and sustainable workplace practices as a distinct basic competency.
Identify resource waste and practical water, electricity and supply conservation opportunities.
Protect safe care and infection prevention while reducing unnecessary consumption.
concepts.source: facilitator-guide PDF 22; presentation slide 77; WHO climate-resilient and environmentally sustainable health care facilities guidance

concepts.statement_en: Reduce unnecessary single-use plastics according to facility policy without reusing clinical single-use items.
concepts.source: facilitator-guide PDF 22 recommendation 3d; Module 3 policy application carried forward

concepts.statement_en: Use orderly storage and a repeatable workplace routine to reduce waste and delays.
concepts.source: facilitator-guide PDF 22 recommendations 5a–b; reference-manual PDF 30 7S supporting application

concepts.statement_en: Improve workflow and resourcefulness while keeping service quality and access intact.
Recommend and explain a resource-saving action to colleagues with an owner and follow-up measure.
concepts.source: facilitator-guide PDF 22 outcomes a–c and recommendation 5; competency table PDF 19

concepts.statement_en: Compare resource use and service quality before and after a change, then retain or revise it.
concepts.source: facilitator-guide PDF 22 recommendation 5e; TESDA BHS NC II sustainable workplace practices evidence guide
